entries.text: This scan turned up 27 issues, every one critical or serious — 5 critical, 22 serious — spread over all 5 pages checked. Fix the footer social icon links first, in src/Shell.jsx (lines 30-32): they wrap only decorative icons that assistive tech skips, so the links announce nothing at all. One edit to that shared footer markup clears all 15 of them. Next, the .muted style on the footer timestamp prints light grey on white, too faint to read; one colour change there settles those 5 elements across every page.
